items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 22 at 3:54PM EDT until October 24 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, moderate coastal
flooding. For the High Rip Current Risk, dangerous rip
currents.

* WHERE...Coastal Broward County and Coastal Miami Dade County.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 8 PM EDT Saturday.
For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 8 PM EDT Saturday. The
advisory will either need to be extended into next week or
upgraded to a warning Sunday into Monday when King Tides peak
and rain chances and onshore winds are highest. For the High
Rip Current Risk, through Saturday evening.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected. Rip currents can sweep even
the best swimmers away from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 22 at 3:55PM EDT until October 24 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 15 to 20 kt and seas 4 to 7 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Jupiter Inlet to Deerfield Beach
FL out 20 NM, Coastal waters from Deerfield Beach to Ocean
Reef FL out 20 NM, Waters from Jupiter Inlet to Deerfield
Beach FL from 20 to 60 NM and Waters from Deerfield Beach to
Ocean Reef FL from 20 to 60 NM excluding the territorial
waters of Bahamas.

* WHEN...Through at least early next week.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
